verdict.rationale: The CRA's own business-registration overview is written in plain, task-oriented language rather than statute text. It explains what you can register in one flow, routes users conditionally ("If you do not know your BN, go to..."), forks non-resident founders to their own path, and points to the provincial registration hand-off. However, the evidence shows short orienting guidance more than full numbered step-by-step walkthroughs, so the depth of the explainers is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of explicit sequential step-by-step instructions for founder tasks, plain-language coverage beyond registration (e.g., GST/HST collection, payroll), independent or hands-on confirmation that non-lawyers can follow it.
